appDescription: The receiving vehicle B in a highway hazard warning prototype. Separate from the primary Beatbox Mate roadside assistance app.

function.name: START_ROADSIDE_SUPPORT
function.description: Start a simulated local roadside incident in the receiving vehicle B test app (세이프티스탭 데모). Does not call emergency services.

function.name: REPORT_OCCUPANT_STATUS
function.description: Record a simulated occupant role and self-reported need for help in the receiving vehicle B test app (세이프티스탭 데모). Requires an active local incident.

help.description: Whether the occupant reports needing assistance.

function.name: GET_ROADSIDE_STATUS
function.description: Get the simulated local roadside support status from the receiving vehicle B test app (세이프티스탭 데모), without claiming emergency dispatch.
